title: Towards Hyperparameter Transfer for Differentially Private Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.22976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling laws and hyperparameter tuning remain central challenges in training large-scale models, particularly under differential privacy (DP), where optimization is further complicated by noise injection and per-sample gradient clipping. While Maximal Update Parametrization ($\mu$P) allows for zero-shot hyperparameter transfer in standard training, we show that it fails under DP constraints due to the distinct spectral properties of high-dimensional noise versus low-rank gradients. In this work, we introduce DP-$\mu$P, a theoretically grounded framework that extends $\mu$P to the privacy-preserving setting. By analyzing the interaction between gradient clipping, noise injection, and feature learning, we derive a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) condition that governs layer-wise learning rate scaling. Combining this with our proposed spectral scaling formulation, we provide specific scaling rules for DP-SGD, DP-Adam, and DP-Muon optimizers. Em

translated_title: 迈向差分隐私优化的超参数迁移
translated_abstract: 缩放定律与超参数调优仍然是训练大规模模型的核心挑战，尤其在差分隐私（DP）条件下，由于噪声注入和逐样本梯度裁剪，优化问题变得更加复杂。虽然最大更新参数化（μP）能够在标准训练中实现零样本超参数迁移，但我们证明了在DP约束下它会失效，原因在于高维噪声与低秩梯度具有截然不同的谱特性。在本工作中，我们提出了DP-μP，这是一个具有理论依据的框架，将μP扩展到了隐私保护场景。通过分析梯度裁剪、噪声注入与特征学习之间的相互作用，我们推导出了一个控制逐层学习率缩放的信噪比（SNR）条件。结合我们提出的谱缩放公式，我们为DP-SGD、DP-Adam和DP-Muon优化器给出了具体的缩放规则。
tldr: 本文提出DP-μP框架，将最大更新参数化（μP）扩展到差分隐私设置，通过信噪比条件与谱缩放公式为DP-SGD、DP-Adam和DP-Muon优化器提供了逐层学习率缩放规则，从而实现差分隐私训练中的超参数迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DP-μP, a theoretically grounded framework extending Maximal Update Parametrization to differentially private optimization, deriving SNR-based layer-wise learning rate scaling rules for DP-SGD, DP-Adam, and DP-Muon to enable hyperparameter transfer under privacy constraints.
